card.name: Punctuation before a descriptive word
card.fires_on: Dashes, opening brackets or quotes, and small linking words like "from" or "a" in general prose, just before an adjective or noun is about to come. Mostly history, culture or description text, not drug labels.

modes.label: Dash or bracket
modes.description: A dash or opening parenthesis that starts an aside or an explanation.
modes.example: others<<—>>men who had grown up in the

modes.label: Opening quote
modes.description: An opening quotation mark before a quoted descriptive word.

modes.label: Linking word or space
modes.description: A small linking word or blank gap before a descriptive noun phrase.
modes.example: the tenor drum descended<< from>> the medieval tabor.

card.writes: It slightly favors name-like starts such as Per, Span, Mal, Arg and Lat, which are nationality and place beginnings.
card.plain: It marks a spot in ordinary prose where a descriptive word, often a nationality or origin, is about to follow.
